I have received information about a recent suspicious shipment of TerraGroup cargo. According to the description, it could contain valuable records and even medical samples. Every such shipment should have been prioritized for extraction, yet for some reason this shipment was left near the customs terminal. I have to know what's inside the cargo, and to do that, I need the exact location of the shipments. Will you be able to assist with this? You will recognize the necessary shipments by the boxes with the TerraGroup logo.}} ==Objectives== * Mark any of the special TerraGroup cargo boxes with an [[MS2000 Marker]] on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the first special TerraGroup cargo on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the second special TerraGroup cargo on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the third special TerraGroup cargo on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the fourth special TerraGroup cargo on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the fifth special TerraGroup cargo on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the sixth special TerraGroup cargo on [[Customs]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the seventh special TerraGroup cargo on [[Customs]] ==Rewards== * +9,400 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.02''' * 45,000 Roubles ** 47,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1 ** 51,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2 * 3× [[Propital regenerative stimulant injector]] {{quote|Excellent!
